label: Figure 17.5: The demand for money
alt: A downward-sloping demand curve for money, DM. At a higher nominal interest rate i1 the quantity of money demanded is Q1; at a lower rate i2 it is the larger Q2.
caption: The demand curve for money D<sub>M</sub> slopes downward. When the nominal interest rate falls from i<sub>1</sub> to i<sub>2</sub> (purple arrow on the vertical axis), the opportunity cost of holding money falls and the quantity demanded rises from Q<sub>1</sub> to Q<sub>2</sub>.
